def transform(grid):
    # Select the largest connected non-background color object and return its color as a 3x3 block.
    from collections import deque, Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); n=0
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); n+=1
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==v:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((n,v))
    color=max(comps)[1]
    return [[color]*3 for _ in range(3)]
PY
